package.name: school_traffic_control
package.description: Decision-making node for school traffic control. Consumes vehicle and pedestrian detections (traffic_perception_msgs), a base-scan close proximity signal, a plate-allowed bool, a force-plate-allowed override, drone-based parking counts (drone_traffic_perception), and an emergency flag; drives the robot base (base_navigation GoToXYPhi action) and arm gestures (play_motion2 PlayMotion2 action) to hold, stop, and wave vehicles through a crossing, tracking a queue of up to two cars. Pedestrians and vehicle stop/pass events trigger audio clips via the robot_audio PlayAudio action and never affect motion. Publishes a structured JSON event on every state transition/trigger for field-trial data collection — see decision_making/benchmark_logging.
